in_sanskrit.name: Rajnikant
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है King, Ruler
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rajnikant एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Rajni means king and Kant means end or limit. So, the name Rajnikant can be interpreted as one who is the king of a limit or one who has the power to set limits.

in_marathi.name: Rajnikant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajnikant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rajni means king and Kant means end or limit. So, the name Rajnikant can be interpreted as one who is the king of a limit or one who has the power to set limits.

in_bengali.name: Rajnikant
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ King, Ruler
in_bengali.long_meaning: Rajnikant একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Rajni means king and Kant means end or limit. So, the name Rajnikant can be interpreted as one who is the king of a limit or one who has the power to set limits.
